goal.en: Negotiate the discount and contract terms without giving too much away.
goal.zh: 談定折扣與合約條件，又不讓步過頭。

background: bright corporate conference room with a glass wall, oval white table, six gray office chairs, a water pitcher and glasses, modern pendant lights, city view through tall windows

intro.en: Daybreak wants to roll out your system in all eight cafes. Ms. Novak has come to Brightway to discuss terms.
intro.zh: 破曉咖啡想在八家分店全面導入你們的系統。諾瓦克女士來到 Brightway 談合約條件。

intro.en: You lead today, Kai. Remember: never give something without getting something back.
intro.zh: 今天你主談，凱。記住：每次讓步都要換到一點東西。

lines.en: We're ready to order for all eight cafes. But we need fifteen percent off the list price.
lines.zh: 我們準備為八家分店下單。但我們需要定價打八五折。

choices.en: If you could sign a three-year contract, we could look at something closer to ten percent.
choices.zh: 如果您能簽三年合約，我們可以考慮接近九折的優惠。
choices.tip: If you could..., we could... 用條件句交換條件，讓步的同時也換到東西。

choices.en: Fifteen percent? No problem at all! Actually, I could probably give you twenty if you want.
choices.zh: 八五折？完全沒問題！其實您要的話，我大概可以給到八折。

lines.en: Kai, could I have a quick word with you outside?
lines.zh: 凱，可以出來一下跟我說句話嗎？

story.en: Ms. Novak smiles for the first time today. Ms. Wong does not.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士今天第一次露出笑容。王經理沒有。

fail.why: 對方一開價就答應，甚至主動加碼，等於把公司的利潤送出去，也超出你的授權。讓步要換條件：If you could sign a three-year contract, we could...。

choices.en: Fifteen percent is too much. Can you be more sincere? We are also very sincere to you.
choices.zh: 八五折太多了。您能不能有誠意一點？我們對您也很有誠意。

lines.en: More sincere? Are you suggesting I'm being dishonest?
lines.zh: 更有誠意？你是在暗示我不誠實嗎？

story.en: Ms. Novak spends five minutes explaining her integrity. The discount question does not move an inch.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士花了五分鐘說明自己的職業操守。折扣問題完全沒有進展。

fail.why: 中文議價時說「有誠意一點」很常見，但英文 Be more sincere. 等於說對方不誠實，非常冒犯。改用條件交換：If you could..., we could...。

lines.en: Ten percent isn't enough. Our board is expecting a better offer than that.
lines.zh: 九折不夠。我們的董事會期待更好的條件。

choices.en: I see. What if we included free maintenance for the first two years? That adds real value.
choices.zh: 了解。如果我們加上前兩年免費維修呢？這是實實在在的價值。
choices.tip: What if we included...? 用附加價值代替降價，守住價格又給對方台階。

choices.en: If you will sign five years, we will can give you more discount, maybe twelve or thirteen percent.
choices.zh: 如果你們簽五年，我們可以給更多折扣，大概八八折或八七折。

lines.en: Twelve or thirteen? Which one? I'll take thirteen, then.
lines.zh: 十二還是十三？到底哪個？那我就選十三。

story.en: Your vague offer becomes a firm thirteen percent in Ms. Novak's notes. Ms. Wong closes her eyes for a long moment.
story.zh: 你模糊的提議在諾瓦克女士的筆記裡變成了確定的八七折。王經理閉上眼睛好一會兒。

fail.why: if 子句不用 will，要說 If you sign...；will 和 can 不能連用，要說 we can 或 we could。談判時給範圍等於讓對方挑高的，提出附加價值更好：What if we included free maintenance?

choices.en: Then your board is being unrealistic. Ten percent is our final price. Take it or leave it.
choices.zh: 那是你們董事會不切實際。九折就是我們的最終價格，要不要隨便你們。

lines.en: In that case, I'll leave it. Thank you for your time.
lines.zh: 既然如此，那我選擇不要。謝謝你的時間。

story.en: Ms. Novak picks up her folder and heads for the door. Ms. Wong spends the afternoon on the phone trying to win her back.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士拿起資料夾走向門口。王經理花了一整個下午打電話想把她挽回。

fail.why: 批評對方董事會又丟出 Take it or leave it.，語氣太強硬，談判很容易破局。改用附加價值：What if we included free maintenance for the first two years?

lines.en: Free maintenance helps. But we're still apart on price. I was hoping for twelve percent.
lines.zh: 免費維修有幫助。但價格上我們還有差距。我原本希望是八八折。

choices.en: Let's meet halfway: eleven percent with free maintenance, if payment is within thirty days.
choices.zh: 我們各退一步：八九折加免費維修，條件是三十天內付款。
choices.tip: meet halfway 是「各退一步」的道地說法，最後再加一個小條件保護自己。

choices.en: Let's both take one step back. You go back one step, and I go back one step too, okay?
choices.zh: 我們各退一步吧。您退一步，我也退一步，好嗎？

lines.en: Step back? From the table? I'm not sure what we're doing.
lines.zh: 往後退？離開桌子嗎？我不太懂我們要做什麼。

story.en: For one confusing moment, both of you push your chairs back. Ms. Wong quietly translates your idea into numbers.
story.zh: 有那麼一個混亂的瞬間，你們兩個都把椅子往後推。王經理默默把你的意思翻成數字。

fail.why: 「各退一步」直譯成 take one step back 不是英文的議價說法。要說 Let's meet halfway. 或 Let's split the difference.，再說出具體數字。

choices.en: Twelve? Oh, that's my lucky number! I was born on December twelfth, actually. What a coincidence!
choices.zh: 十二？那是我的幸運數字！其實我是十二月十二日出生的，好巧喔！

lines.en: Lovely. So... does that mean twelve percent is agreed?
lines.zh: 真好。所以……這代表同意八八折了嗎？

story.en: Ms. Novak happily takes your birthday as a yes. Twelve percent goes into the contract.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士開心地把你的生日當成同意。八八折就這樣寫進了合約。

fail.why: 談判關鍵時刻扯到生日，不但離題，還可能被當成默許。回到數字上：Let's meet halfway: eleven percent with free maintenance.。

lines.en: Eleven could work. One more thing: we'd want the right to cancel anytime, with no penalty.
lines.zh: 八九折或許可以。還有一件事：我們希望能隨時解約，而且不用付違約金。

choices.en: I'm afraid that would be a deal-breaker for us. Could we offer a ninety-day exit option instead?
choices.zh: 這點恐怕會讓我們無法接受。我們改提供九十天的解約選項，可以嗎？
choices.tip: I'm afraid that would be a deal-breaker. 委婉但明確地劃出底線，再提出替代方案。

choices.en: Sure, cancel anytime, no problem at all. I'll just explain it to my boss later.
choices.zh: 當然，隨時解約都沒問題。我之後再跟老闆解釋就好。

lines.en: Actually, Kai, your boss is sitting right here.
lines.zh: 其實，凱，你的老闆就坐在這裡。

story.en: Ms. Wong takes over the rest of the negotiation. You take very detailed notes.
story.zh: 王經理接手了剩下的談判。你做了非常詳細的筆記。

fail.why: 超出授權範圍隨口答應，還說「之後再跟老闆解釋」，既是過度承諾，也讓公司難做。遇到底線要明說：I'm afraid that would be a deal-breaker for us.。

choices.en: That's fine. We trust each other now, so we don't really need to write everything in the contract.
choices.zh: 沒關係。我們現在互相信任，所以不需要每件事都寫進合約。

lines.en: Not in the contract? In my experience, if it's not written down, it doesn't exist.
lines.zh: 不寫進合約？依我的經驗，沒寫下來的就等於不存在。

story.en: Ms. Novak adds a page to the contract instead of removing one. Her version says she can cancel anytime.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士不但沒刪條款，還多加了一頁。她的版本寫著可以隨時解約。

fail.why: 在西方商務文化中，合約就是一切，「我們互相信任，不必寫」反而讓人不安。底線要明確寫清楚：I'm afraid that would be a deal-breaker. Could we offer a ninety-day exit option?

lines.en: A ninety-day exit... I can live with that. So, do we have a deal?
lines.zh: 九十天的解約期……我可以接受。那麼，我們成交了嗎？

choices.en: I believe we do. I'll put everything in writing and send it to you this afternoon.
choices.zh: 我想是的。我會把所有內容寫成書面，今天下午寄給您。
choices.tip: 談成之後立刻說 I'll put everything in writing.，把口頭共識變成白紙黑字。

choices.en: Yes, deal! I will send you the contract after I go back company, then you sign it.
choices.zh: 對，成交！我回公司後再把合約寄給您，然後您簽名。

lines.en: After you go back... company? We're in your company right now.
lines.zh: 等你回……公司之後？我們現在就在你們公司啊。

story.en: Ms. Novak laughs, but she also reminds you to read the contract twice before sending it.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士笑了出來，但也提醒你寄出前要把合約看兩遍。

fail.why: 「回公司」要說 go back to the office，不能說 go back company；而且你們就在 Brightway。簡單說 I'll put everything in writing and send it to you this afternoon.。

choices.en: Finally! That took forever. I honestly thought you would never stop asking for discounts, haha.
choices.zh: 終於！談了好久。我真的以為您永遠不會停止要折扣，哈哈。

lines.en: Asking for discounts is my job, Kai. Perhaps I should keep asking.
lines.zh: 要折扣是我的工作，凱。也許我應該繼續要。

story.en: Ms. Novak reopens the discussion on delivery fees. The deal you almost had takes another hour.
story.zh: 諾瓦克女士重新提起運費的問題。本來快到手的合約又多談了一小時。

fail.why: 成交時抱怨對方難搞，會讓剛建立的關係受傷，對方也可能重新開價。保持專業：I believe we do. I'll put everything in writing.。

lines.en: You drive a fair bargain, Kai. I'll look out for that contract.
lines.zh: 你談得很公道，凱。我會留意那份合約。

lines.en: Eleven percent, a three-year term, and payment in thirty days. Well done.
lines.zh: 八九折、三年合約、三十天內付款。做得好。

story.en: You shake hands on eight cafes. Back at your desk, Ms. Wong leaves a sticky note on your monitor: "Good trade-offs."
story.zh: 你們握手談定八家分店的案子。回到座位時，王經理在你的螢幕上貼了一張便利貼：「交換得漂亮。」

notes.explain: 談判時用假設語氣交換條件，語氣委婉又能保護自己。注意 if 子句不用 will，也不說 will can。

example.en: If you could pay in advance, we could include free installation.
example.zh: 如果您能預付，我們就可以免費安裝。

notes.explain: 雙方差距不大時的折衷說法，也可以說 Let's split the difference.。直譯的 take one step back 不是議價用語。

example.en: You want twelve, we offered ten. Let's meet halfway at eleven.
example.zh: 您要十二，我們給十。各退一步，就十一吧。

notes.explain: 指會讓交易破局的條件。前面加 I'm afraid 或 would be，語氣會更委婉：That would be a deal-breaker for us.。

example.en: Late delivery would be a deal-breaker for our hotel.
example.zh: 延遲交貨對我們飯店來說是無法接受的。

notes.explain: 中文議價常說「有誠意一點」，但英文這樣說等於指控對方不誠實。想請對方讓步，改說 Is there any flexibility on that?。

example.en: Is there any flexibility on the delivery date?

notes.explain: 西方商務重視書面合約，口頭承諾或「我們互相信任」不夠。談定後主動說 I'll put everything in writing.，對方會覺得你很專業。

example.en: Great. I'll put everything in writing and send it today.
example.zh: 太好了。我會把一切寫成書面，今天寄出。
